# 03 · Permission Matrix

Calculated with an offline copy of Discord's permission algorithm (`src/blueprint/compile.js`) from the exact overwrites the setup script writes. The automated tests in `test/permissions.test.js` check the most important rules of this table.

## Channel access by member type

Columns:

- **Unv** = Unverified newcomer (@everyone): no roles
- **Res** = Restricted Member: Restricted Member
- **New** = New Member (first 7 days): Verified Member + New Member + Civilian
- **Civ** = Verified civilian: Verified Member + Community Member + Civilian
- **Biz** = Business owner: Verified Member + Community Member + Civilian + Business Owner
- **Pol** = Department member (City Police): Verified Member + Community Member + City Police
- **PCmd** = Department leader (City Police Command): Verified Member + Community Member + City Police + City Police Command
- **Int** = Intelligence Service officer: Verified Member + Community Member + Intelligence Service
- **Gov** = Government official: Verified Member + Community Member + Government Official
- **SecE** = Secretary for Economy and Education: Verified Member + Community Member + Secretary for Economy and Education
- **Ldr** = Leader of the Revolution: Verified Member + Community Member + Leader of the Revolution
- **EcoA** = Economic Administrator (staff): Verified Member + Community Member + Economic Administrator
- **Sup** = Support Team: Verified Member + Community Member + Support Team
- **Mod** = Moderator: Verified Member + Community Member + Moderator
- **Adm** = Administrator: Verified Member + Community Member + Administrator
- **Own** = Owner: Owner
- **Bot** = Economy bot: Economy bot

Text channels: **–** cannot see · **R** read only · **W** read and write · **M** write and moderate (delete messages, manage threads) · **A** everything (Discord Administrator).
Voice channels: **–** cannot see · **L** listen only · **S** speak · **M** speak and move/mute members.

### TICKETS

Each ticket channel: the member who opened it (read, write, attach files), the reviewer roles of the ticket type, Administrators (moderate) and the bot. Nobody else. Restricted Members can only open appeal tickets.

## Economy bot permissions (in-game powers)

These are checked by the bot, not by Discord. They come from in-game offices. Discord staff roles do not grant them (except the separate Economic Administrator staff role for technical corrections), and they never grant Discord moderation rights. The Owner can use every command as an emergency override.

| Bot permission | What it allows | Roles |
|---|---|---|
| `treasury.view` | View detailed public finances, budgets and pending spending | Economic Administrator, Leader of the Revolution, Secretary-General, Secretary for Economy and Education, General People's Congress Representative |
| `treasury.spend` | Request public spending (executed at once up to 25,000 KGD, otherwise needs a second approver) | Secretary for Economy and Education, Secretary-General, Leader of the Revolution |
| `treasury.approve` | Approve or reject spending requests of other officials | Secretary for Economy and Education, Secretary-General, Leader of the Revolution |
| `treasury.budget` | Set budget lines for the current 30-day budget period | Secretary for Economy and Education, Secretary-General, Leader of the Revolution |
| `treasury.wages` | Change public-sector wages | Secretary for Economy and Education, Secretary-General, Leader of the Revolution |
| `policy.set` | Change tax rates, fees, tariffs, export duties, export bans and the policy rate (within fixed limits) | Secretary for Economy and Education, Secretary-General, Leader of the Revolution |
| `registry.review` | Approve, reject, suspend and reinstate businesses | Secretary for Economy and Education, Government Official, Economic Administrator |
| `credit.review` | Approve or reject loan applications above the automatic limit | Secretary for Economy and Education, Economic Administrator |
| `avk.review` | Decide AVK insurance claims | AVK Officer |
| `fines.issue` | Issue fines | City Police, City Police Command, Gendarmerie, Gendarmerie Command, Judge |
| `fines.cancel` | Cancel fines (e.g. after an appeal) | Judge, Economic Administrator |
| `property.state` | Create and manage state-owned property | Secretary for Internal Affairs and Infrastructure, Economic Administrator |
| `econ.admin` | Corrections up to 10,000 KGD, freezes, inspections, events, tick recovery, audit log | Economic Administrator |
| `panels.post` | Post verification and ticket panels | Administrator |
| `mod.members` | Verify members by hand, restrict and unrestrict members (/mod) | Moderator, Administrator |

Additional built-in limits: officials cannot approve their own spending, registry staff cannot approve their own business, AVK officers cannot decide claims on their own policies, Economic Administrators may correct at most 10,000 KGD per action (more needs the Owner), and Central Bank financing of the treasury is Owner-only.
